images.after: Lock the server down on first login
images.title: Lock down a new VPS
images.alt: Four steps to secure a new VPS: create a sudo user, turn off root and password logins, enable the ufw firewall and turn on automatic security updates.
images.caption: These four steps take about fifteen minutes on first login.

items.title: Create a regular user
items.text: Give it sudo rights and your SSH key, then test it in a second terminal

items.title: Turn off root and passwords
items.text: Disable root and password logins in sshd config, check, restart SSH

items.title: Enable the firewall
items.text: Allow SSH and web traffic with ufw, and nothing else

items.title: Turn on security updates
items.text: Install unattended-upgrades. Kernel updates still need a reboot

images.after: Run your first app with Docker and automatic HTTPS
images.title: From empty server to app on HTTPS
images.alt: Flow for running a first self-hosted app: install Docker, point a subdomain at the server, write compose.yaml and a Caddyfile, then start everything.
images.caption: Only Caddy gets a ports line. Ports Docker publishes bypass ufw.

items.label: Install Docker Engine
items.text: Use Docker's official instructions for your distribution

items.label: Point a subdomain
items.text: Create an A record with the server's IP before starting Caddy

items.label: Write compose.yaml
items.text: Caddy as the reverse proxy, then the app underneath

items.label: Add a Caddyfile
items.text: Send your subdomain to the app, such as kuma:3001

items.label: Start everything
items.text: docker compose up -d; Caddy gets and renews the certificate
